integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action cinematic scene, the young Asian woman shown in <Picture 1> remains on the same rain-soaked urban street at night, preserving her facial appearance, shoulder-length black hair, dark navy trench coat, white shirt, transparent umbrella, body proportions, position, and the surrounding storefronts and wet pavement. She stands slightly left of center and faces the camera with a calm expression. At the beginning of the shot, she pauses briefly beneath the umbrella, then starts walking slowly toward the camera. Her steps are natural and relaxed, while her coat and loose strands of hair respond subtly to the light wind. The transparent umbrella remains in her hand and moves naturally with her walking rhythm.

The camera smoothly tracks backward in front of her at a slow, steady speed, maintaining the same general medium-wide composition. As she walks forward, she gradually turns her head toward a warmly illuminated storefront on her right and briefly looks at it, then returns her gaze toward the direction of travel. The wet pavement continues reflecting the surrounding warm and cool lights, while the background shifts gradually with subtle natural parallax. Rain continues falling throughout the shot, with small droplets visible on the umbrella and pavement.

The woman's appearance, clothing, hairstyle, umbrella, proportions, and the overall street environment remain consistent throughout the continuous shot. The action develops naturally from the exact first-frame state without a cut or abrupt transition.

non_diegetic_music: Soft cinematic ambient music with a restrained, atmospheric mood, gradually developing underneath the natural street ambience without overpowering it.
